name: Roark
answers:
## Roark (cap 16, permanent sand) — high for sets

Local trainer data: Bonsly (SR + Sash + SelfDestruct), Lileep (Solid Rock / Giga Drain / Sludge Bomb), Gible (Sand Veil + coverage), Corsola (Solid Rock / Recover / Water Pulse / LS), Shuckle (Toxic / stall), Cranidos (Head Smash / Zen Headbutt / Crunch / Rock Polish, Lum).

Death traps: Sash Bonsly SelfDestruct, Sand Veil accuracy, Solid Rock stalls, Cranidos after Rock Polish, sand residual.

Community deathless tools (medium; Reddit snapshot): Luvdisc (Charm / Aqua Jet); tanky Steel/Ground (Aron, Rhyhorn, Sandshrew, Mawile, Wormadam) for Cranidos; Toxic; Prinplup/Grotle appear in clears. Prefer pack sets + PKCalc over memorizing one “meta” team.

## Gardenia (cap 28, permanent rain, gauntlet) — high for sets

Includes Miltank (SR), Rotom-Mow (Leaf Storm / Thunder in rain), Ludicolo (Swift Swim / SD), Milotic (Filter), Roserade, Torterra. Planning spine: rain + Swift Swim + Thunder accuracy. Fire depth from Oreburgh / 207 matters because starter Fire is not unique.
